import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    # 2500*2=5000 >= 5000 -> free
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_issue_just_below_50_charged():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    # 4999 < 5000 -> 599
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599


def test_issue_just_above_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5001, qty=1))
    # 5001 >= 5000 -> free
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_issue_discounted_to_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5500, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    # 5500-500=5000 >= 5000 -> free
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_issue_quantities_sum_to_exactly_50_free():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=2000, qty=1))
    # 1000*3+2000*1=5000 >= 5000 -> free
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_issue_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    # empty -> 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_contract_subtotal_is_sum():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=250, qty=3))
    # 1000*2+250*3=2000+750=2750
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2750


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="X", name="X", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="X", name="X", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    # 1000*2=2000
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2000


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=3000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")


def test_contract_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # floor(199*10/100)=floor(19.9)=19
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 19


def test_contract_fixed_needs_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the minimum."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1999, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    # 1999 < 2000 -> 0
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up_no_shipping_tax():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up; shipping is not taxed."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=10, qty=1))
    # 10*8/100=0.8 -> 1
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 1


def test_contract_total_formula():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=6000, qty=1))
    # 6000+0+480=6480 where tax 6000*8/100=480
    assert cart.total_cents() == 6480
